extracted.intended_audience: players and collectors of the Connections word puzzle (word-game solvers)
extracted.subtask_description: An archive of daily 'Connections' puzzle group labels (themes/categories) where each group lists four example words that belong together. Useful for studying/creating category-based word puzzles or for seeing common theme types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily group/category theme
rubrics_metrics.description: Each color group (Yellow/Green/Blue/Purple) is a theme or category that connects four words. The theme is stated (often as a short phrase) and four example words are given that fit that theme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
This page is an archive listing many daily Connections groups (e.g., 'THINGS THAT ARE LONG AND CYLINDRICAL: BATON, CIGAR, HOAGIE, TORPEDO' (May 4, 2025 #693); 'QUALITIES OF OVERCOOKED MEAT: CHEWY, DRY, STRINGY, TOUGH'; 'PLAY SOME ELECTRIC GUITAR: JAM, NOODLE, SHRED, SOLO'; 'INGREDIENTS IN BUBBLE TEA: BOBA, MILK, SUGAR, TEA'). Each entry follows the pattern: Color Group: THEME: word1, word2, word3, word4. The archive contains many such theme+examples across dates from December 2024 through May 2025 in this chunk. Use the theme phrase as the evaluative/production criterion when creating or classifying groups; the four sample words demonstrate valid members. Examples from the page (representative, not exhaustive):
- 'AWESOME: DOPE, FIRE, LIT, SICK'
- 'MOVIE CAMERA VERBS: DOLLY, PAN, TILT, ZOOM'
- 'PARTS OF A TREE: BRANCH, LEAF, ROOT, TRUNK'
- 'CLUES AT A CRIME SCENE: FIBER, FINGERPRINT, HAIR, TIRE MARK'
- 'GUM FLAVORS: BUBBLEGUM, CINNAMON, MENTHOL, WINTERGREEN'
- 'WHO VIDEO GAMES ARE FOR, PER ESRB RATINGS: ADULTS ONLY, EVERYONE, TEEN, MATURE'
- 'CLASSIC JOKE STAPLES: BAR, CHICKEN, KNOCK-KNOCK, LIGHT BULB'

Note: the page lists dozens/hundreds of distinct theme phrases (one per group) each with four example words; treat each theme phrase on the page as an individual category/rubric for grouping words.
